context: One simulated founder at localhost:5317; observed UI evidence; fixes requested. Do not infer actual user satisfaction or adoption.

items.claim: Valid local browser form submissions are rejected.
items.expected: Add Person saves a record through normal HTML forms.
items.basis: README promises normal links/forms complete workflows.
items.observations: IAB valid Add Person and Add Task did not advance. Native Chrome Guest Add Person displayed Browser requests must come from this workspace. After changing only Referrer-Policy from no-referrer to same-origin and rebuilding, same IAB form created Person and subsequent Task/meeting/watch/project forms worked.
items.counterevidence: Server-only route tests and earlier curl smoke passed; they did not exercise browser-generated Origin.

items.claim: Content generation controls offer actions before their required review state, causing avoidable error navigation.
items.expected: Unavailable steps explain prerequisites and become available after approval.
items.basis: Visible staged evidence/outline/draft workflow and server review requirement.
items.observations: New project showed enabled Generate draft. Click produced Unable to continue / Review the evidence before generating an outline or draft. Back returned to project. After evidence and outline approval, generation succeeded.
items.counterevidence: Server correctly rejects premature calls; error message is accurate; browser Back recovers project; no data loss observed.

items.claim: Meeting draft history and details display raw millisecond epochs as saved dates.
items.expected: A person can read when a draft was saved.
items.basis: Convention for history/revision metadata and visible saved label.
items.observations: Meeting history link debrief · 1791893760095; artifact detail Provider: mistral · awaiting review · saved 1791893760095. Same on regenerated brief.
items.counterevidence: Artifact body, type and links remain usable; this is minor metadata interpretation burden.

items.claim: Research active watches remains enabled when all watches are paused.
items.expected: Explain add/resume requirement and enable after active watch exists.
items.basis: Button says active watches; page promises pause without losing history.
items.observations: Ran watch successfully, then paused sole watch. Button remained enabled. Click navigated to Unable to continue / Add an active watch before running research. Back retained paused watch and saved report.
items.counterevidence: Backend correctly prevents an empty Run; saved report persists. Minor recoverable burden, no data loss.

items.claim: Meeting state selector fails to reflect saved state and can overwrite completed status on repeated save.
items.expected: Saved completed/cancelled state remains selected after redirect and repeated unchanged save preserves it.
items.basis: Existing edit form convention and explicit Set state action.
items.observations: Selected completed and Set state. Summary changed to completed, but State remained scheduled. Pressed Set state again without changing selection: summary became scheduled. Source form hardcodes options without selected attribute.
items.counterevidence: Server stores explicitly submitted state correctly; backend state transition itself is sound.
